name: The First
caption: A goth, Raven-like wrestler from Salem, Massachusetts: the first UCW World Heavyweight Champion by the owner's title history, who lost it to Irishred, won it back by pinning him in the Elimination Chamber at Scars and Stripes in September 2006, and was still champion at Night of the Legends II in February 2007.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum posts, 26 June 2006 to 11 March 2007.

identity.note: The name or an alias is shared with an existing record on another wing; nothing in either source links the two, so they are kept apart.

name: Irishred
caption: The 'leader and founder of the Midwest Mafia' of his own bio, from Yankton, South Dakota: UCW World Heavyweight Champion through the summer of 2006 ('the Irishred era'), who lost it in the Elimination Chamber, won the LVW title at Night of the Legends II and repainted it as the B4B Championship.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum posts, 26 June 2006 to 11 March 2007.

Billed on the promotion's own cards. Also corroborated by: His own EPW roster profile (posted 1-4 December 2006) plus the fed's own 2007 Moment of the Year and Angle of the Year ballots, which nominate his on-screen defeat of owner Dan Ryan and six-month takeover of the promotion as a 2007 event.

identity.note: The name or an alias is shared with an existing record on another wing; nothing in either source links the two, so they are kept apart.

name: Damon Blackburn
caption: 'Mr. A1E', a 6'2" 265-pound wrestler from Detroit and Hollywood who held the A1E Triple Star, Survivor and tag titles and, in the build to Civil War, 'stole' a win as what the commentators called the de facto champion.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum posts, 1 July 2006 to 13 July 2006.

name: BG Bruce
caption: 'Big Gay Bruce', a 6'10" 420-pound super-heavyweight in black biker leathers and the partner of Estaban; he returned as the masked Midnight Rider in white leather, was revealed at Scars and Stripes and had a long feud with Commissioner Cloverleaf.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum posts, 1 July 2006 to 11 March 2007.

identity.note: The name or an alias is shared with an existing record on another wing; nothing in either source links the two, so they are kept apart.

name: Estaban
caption: A 120-pound make-up artist, Bruce's valet and life partner, forced into the ring by Commissioner Cloverleaf: a winner by DQ over Promo on 17 June 2006 and half of the team of Bruce and Estaban.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum posts, 27 June 2006 to 10 March 2007.

name: Mr. Incredible
caption: A masked, flag-clad 'American legend', a retired patriot who refereed the United States title match at Scars and Stripes, hosted 'Incredible Knows Best' and fought Adam Benjamin in a Survivor Rules match at Night of the Legends II.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum posts, 1 July 2006 to 12 February 2007.

name: Shawn Hart
caption: 'The Phenom', a debutant of the autumn of 2006 who fought Jimmy Donovan in November and went wild on Jonathan Marx on 9 December.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum posts, 13 September 2006 to 11 March 2007.

identity.note: The name or an alias is shared with an existing record on another wing; nothing in either source links the two, so they are kept apart.

name: Beau Michaels
caption: A debuting wrestler of the Civil War four-way for the first United States Title, whom the commentators call a 'fruit', and a victim of BG Bruce's Gayvalanche.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum posts, 1 July 2006 to 12 February 2007.
Billed on the promotion's own cards. Also corroborated by: His own EPW roster profile (posted 22 March to 9 August 2007) both predates and extends the previously recorded single-month appearance.

identity.note: The name or an alias is shared with an existing record on another wing; nothing in either source links the two, so they are kept apart.

A Beau Michaels also wrestles in the held NFW wing; no corroborating evidence found this pass tying this comedic persona to that record specifically, though the corpus's own broader NFW-crossover pattern (FWL-0015) makes a future join worth checking.

name: Benoitholic Anonymous
caption: A comic submission specialist from Philadelphia who lost his UCW debut to John Doe at Civil War and was beaten by AJ Cirrus on 17 June 2006.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own forum post of 1 July 2006.

name: Professor Tremendous
caption: The CSWA Unified Champion who defended his title in a special appearance on UCW's 23 September 2006 card against Jimmy Donovan and Mateo.
